goal: Fixed H64/M16/F4: find a D95-safe combination within 1 percent of measured best cycles earlier and reduce cumulative ATPG search wall time

stage_1.name: request_result_runtime_acquisition
stage_1.purpose: Qualify new data collection with 18 prospectively declared actions, not model performance
stage_1.historical_request_recovery: For all six TRAIN families, recover original requested controls by exact invocation provenance where possible; never rename realized patterns as requests
stage_1.completion: Frozen controls, authenticated inputs and mapping, actual attempt and session timings, all 18 action statuses including NOT_ATTEMPTED, independent audit; incomplete labels remain unavailable

stage_2.name: circuit_information_ablation
stage_2.entry: Six TRAIN families have authenticated pre-execution features and matched outcomes/costs; two-circuit pilot alone is insufficient
stage_2.completion_cohort: Require the same F-completion policy and input/environment cohort for compared labels; never pool historical F-boundary and new single-target95 labels as equivalent outcomes
stage_2.structure_definition_gate: Freeze graph node/edge/cell definitions, depth behavior for cycles, fanout quantile definition, and design/mode mapping before extracting values; no guessed or placeholder descriptors
stage_2.later_comparison: Only after the first comparison, test whether GraphSAGE adds benefit beyond qualified static descriptors
stage_2.fit_vs_transfer: Report both fitting-family ranks and held-family ranks; holdout failure does not prove representation is the cause
stage_2.split: Six TRAIN families, leave one family out; normalize using fitting families only
stage_2.controls: Freeze one common ranking objective and equal updates, sampler work and resources before any fit; add structural descriptors as the isolated first comparison variable
stage_2.prior_E30: Existing two-estimator E30 design is historical and unexecuted. Do not silently claim this new representation ablation is the E30 experiment or tune estimators simultaneously
stage_2.d95_head: No single-class D95 head; evaluate safety and keep failed/unsafe rows explicitly
stage_2.s35932: Report all families and separately five informative families; selecting ten out of ten is guaranteed

stage_3.name: prospective_runtime_comparison
stage_3.entry: Freeze selected model and all policy orders before results; acquire separate fair sessions under the same candidate domain and completion policy
stage_3.report: D95 acceptance, K10 hit/no-hit, cycles and cumulative real ATPG and session wall times including failures/timeouts/translation/setup/selection
stage_3.no_hit: Keep paid cost and censoring flag, not success-only average time
stage_3.pilot_policy_change: E84 single coverage-target F is a new acquisition policy; its labels cannot silently replace historical F-boundary/minimality labels or establish full-space optimality
stage_3.blind: Remain sealed during data repair, feature choice and TRAIN model selection

local_implementation_and_readonly_prepar: Current user instruction to execute the preceding plan; preserve earlier protected-data and bounded-execution constraints
